mechanism: Prochlorperazine (phenothiazine) increases photosensitivity risk, and tretinoin also causes significant photosensitivity and skin irritation, resulting in additive dermatological effects and potential phototoxicity.
action: Advise patients to use strict photoprotection (SPF 30+, protective clothing) and consider timing doses to minimize concurrent peak plasma levels; monitor for excessive photosensitivity reactions.
